Hi [@poojaranjan](https://github.com/poojaranjan), could you please add [ethereum/ERCs#1910](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1910) (ERC-8350: Agent Memory State Registry) to the Draft ERCs section for a short discussion during [Office Hour #111](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2192), if time permits?

As autonomous agents become long-lived and stateful, existing identity and reputation standards can help answer who an agent is and how it has performed, but they do not establish how the agent's private memory, policy, or operational state evolved over time.

ERC-8350 proposes a small on-chain registry for authorized, sequential commitments to off-chain agent state. The underlying memory remains private, while its state history can be independently verified.

This could provide useful primitives for:

- auditing the ordered evolution of an agent's state and detecting gaps, rollback, or conflicting histories;
- migrating an agent or its state between operators and platforms while preserving verifiable continuity; and
- recording the provenance of model, policy, or verifier changes, with selective disclosure of supporting evidence without exposing the underlying memory.

The proposal is intended to complement ERC-8004's identity and reputation registries, rather than replace them.

The PR is currently mergeable with all checks passing, and the [Ethereum Magicians discussion](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8350-agent-memory-state-registry/29098) remains active. It is currently awaiting the remaining Editor review.

A short discussion would be valuable for feedback on the scope of a standalone ERC and its boundaries with related proposals such as ERC-8181, ERC-8264, ERC-8269, and ERC-8274.

This is a request for discussion and feedback only; no status change is being requested at this stage.

PR: [ethereum/ERCs#1910](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1910)
